name: MR Stash
summary:
MR Stash is a Mixed Reality media player. 

MR Stash let's you open as many virtual windows as you can handle.

MR Stash has a dedicated Stash media browser with features such as auto-play, dynamic grid sizing, and incremental filtering.

MR Stash has a sophisticated web browser that can scan pages for media to display in VR or in a dedicated video window.

Confirmed for one-handed play.
